author: Vincent Wei
implementation: 一条 SVG 路径贯穿全片，描边进度由 film.js 按时间计算。tools/ 里的脚本从路径算出转角和速度，给配乐卡点。
font_adaptation: Font binaries excluded upstream; bundled open fonts where needed and installed Noto fallback. See mg-upstream/FONT-SOURCES.json. Original video previews are unchanged.
adaptation: Original geometry and motion retained; reviewed text substitutions only, timeline mapped to narration duration. No generated replacement graphics. 3D uses the original final video because Blender plates are absent; Liquid uses its original final video because its raymarcher is expensive on the WSL software GPU. Baked text in those two films is not editable.
